title: Captions.ai Alternative That Works in the Browser
metaDescription: A Captions.ai alternative that runs in your browser: no app to install, captions edited like a text document, and burned-in MP4 exports.
h1: A Captions.ai alternative that runs in your browser
intro: Supertitle runs in any modern browser, on the computer where your videos already are. You fix the captions the way you'd edit a document, pick a style and export an MP4 with the text burned in.
summary: Runs in the browser, with captions edited like a text document.
verdict: Pick Supertitle if you edit on a computer and want a focused tool: upload in the browser, correct the text like a document and export. Stay with Captions.ai if you film and edit on your phone, or if you use its AI features beyond captions.

comparisonTable.startingPaidPrice: $9.99/month (Basic); a $4.99 Lite plan on Android only
comparisonTable.freeTierLimits: One caption template and 60–200 one-time AI credits
comparisonTable.limitsCountedBy: AI credits (200 a month on Basic)
comparisonTable.platform: iPhone and Android apps, and the web
comparisonTable.editingModel: TODO(igor): confirm how captions are edited in Captions.ai (its plan pages list a chat-based editor and traditional editing tools, not the caption editor itself)

whereTheyWin: Mobile app: Captions.ai is built around a phone app, so you can record and edit in the same place. Supertitle has no mobile app.
AI extras: Captions.ai offers AI features that go beyond captions. Supertitle only does captions.

switchingSteps.title: Open Supertitle in your browser
switchingSteps.text: Create a free account and drop in an MP4, MOV or WEBM file. Nothing to install.

switchingSteps.title: Correct the transcript
switchingSteps.text: The captions open as text. Fix a word, split or merge a caption, or nudge its timing.

switchingSteps.title: Style it and download
switchingSteps.text: Start from one of five presets, adjust it, and download an MP4 with the captions burned in.

faq.question: Do I need to install anything?
faq.answer: No. Supertitle runs in your browser. Upload the video, edit the captions and download the MP4 from the same tab.

faq.question: Can I use Supertitle on my phone?
faq.answer: There's no mobile app. Supertitle is built for editing in a browser on a computer, where the text editor has room to work.

faq.question: How do I fix a wrong word?
faq.answer: Open the caption and retype it, like editing a line in a document. You can also split or merge captions and adjust their timing, and the preview follows.

faq.question: What does the free plan include?
faq.answer: {plan.free.monthlyMinutes} minutes of video a month, videos up to {plan.free.maxVideoMinutes} minutes and {plan.free.maxResolution} exports, with no watermark.

cta.heading: Try it in your browser
cta.text: Upload a video and get editable captions in a few minutes, on the free plan.
